reflections.title: "Your Love Is More Delightful Than Wine"

reflect.text: True friendship with Jesus gives the believer greater joy than anything else in life. We may enjoy the good gifts God provides in this world, but all of them put together cannot compare to the delight of knowing Christ. Earthly pleasures are like empty husks when set beside the heavenly nourishment He gives. As Charles Spurgeon puts it, Jesus is "the only true delight."

The believer longs for bold and close fellowship with the Lord. We do not approach Him in fear, but with joyful freedom. Just as we received His welcome and pardon when we first believed, we now ask to feel His affection every day. Faith is the path we walk, but close communion with Jesus is the fresh spring that revives our souls along the way.

questions: Do you look to Jesus for your deepest happiness, or do you search for it in earthly comforts?
How can you seek a closer, daily sense of His presence today?
reflections.prayer: Lord Jesus, Your love is sweeter and more lasting than any pleasure this world can give. Feed my soul with Your presence and let me rest in Your tender affection. Keep me walking closely with You every hour.

reflections.title: "The King Has Brought Me Into His Chambers"

reflect.text: We cannot push our own way into the secret rooms of God's love. Christ must lead us by His grace. As we crown Him Lord in our hearts and obey Him, He guides us forward step by step, from new life to quiet confidence and daily victory. Even when we feel unworthy and dark with sin, He clothes us in His own beauty.

Those who walk uprightly love Jesus more dearly than any earthly treasure or family bond. Persecution and hardship cannot break the bond that ties our hearts to Him. Our only sorrow is that our love is so small compared to what He truly deserves.

Jesus will never let His people forget what He has done. When our memories fade, He comes near to remind us of His cross, His eternal care, and His life given for us. From His humble birth to His empty grave, His entire story is filled with enduring love.

questions: Are you holding on to Jesus above every other earthly relationship or comfort?
When your love feels weak, how does remembering Christ's cross revive your heart?
reflections.prayer: King Jesus, draw me near and lead me into deeper fellowship with You. Forgive me when my affection grows cold, and remind me of all You suffered to make me Yours. Help me to obey Your voice and rejoice in Your steadfast care.

reflections.title: "Tell Me Where You Graze Your Flock"

reflect.text: A believer should not settle for a vague hope about loving Jesus. We ought to seek a clear and sure knowledge, given by the Holy Spirit, that Christ is ours. We love Him because He first loved us, died for us on the cross, and won our hearts by His perfect goodness and beauty.

Because we love Him, our hearts long to be where He feeds and rests His people. We look for our Shepherd in prayer, in the pages of the Bible, and among His gathered church. Satan may whisper that we are too weak or unworthy to approach Him, but our very weakness is the exact reason we need His shelter.

questions: Can you say with quiet certainty that you love Jesus, or are you resting on uncertain hopes?
Where can you meet Christ today to find rest from the heat and stress of life?
reflections.prayer: Good Shepherd, show me where You lead Your sheep and grant me rest beside You. Do not let my feelings of unworthiness keep me away from Your care. Draw my soul into Your presence through Your Word and prayer.

reflections.title: Gazing on the Loveliness of Christ

reflect.text: From every angle and in every season, the Lord Jesus is completely lovely. God uses all our life experiences, both pleasant times and painful trials, to give us new views of Christ. Whether we look at Him in times of joy, from a sickbed, or in the face of deep sorrow, His beauty never fades.

It is a wonderful calling to spend our lives looking at Jesus. We can examine every small action of His earthly walk, His character, and His eternal reign, and we will never find any flaw in Him. Throughout all eternity, His radiant glory will continue to shine and delight our hearts.

questions: How have difficult times or trials helped you see the goodness of Jesus more clearly?
What character trait of Christ brings the greatest comfort to your heart right now?
reflections.prayer: Lord Jesus, You are altogether lovely and without any flaw. Open my eyes to behold Your glory in every circumstance I face. Teach me to find all my joy and satisfaction in who You are.
